title: Injectivity of sign monomial characters
statement: For any type $\iota$, associate to each finite subset $S\subseteq\iota$ the character on sign-valued functions $x:\iota\to\{\pm1\}$ given by $x\mapsto\prod_{i\in S}x(i)$. This association is injective: distinct finite subsets define distinct characters.
